item.title: Bill targeting 3D-printed firearms is on docket in the Colorado legislature this week
item.description: A pair of Democrat-backed gun control bills are set for key steps in the legislative process this week as Colorado lawmakers continue their work in the state Capitol.

item.title: Used EVs under $25,000 propel sales even as new models languish
item.description: EV batteries are proving to be more durable than expected.

item.title: Erie police still pursuing leads in hit-and-run crash that killed toddler
item.description: Erie police are asking any witnesses to reach out as they continue to investigate a Sunday afternoon hit-and-run crash that killed a 2-year-old.

item.title: Judge blocks deportation of Palestinian activist who led protests at Columbia
item.description: The judge said she terminated the case because of a procedural misstep by government attorneys.

item.title: FBI, St. Paul police probing ICE arrest that resulted in skull fractures
item.description: ICE said he caused the injury when he tried to run while handcuffed and fell.

item.title: NASA hopes fuel leaks are fixed as it launches another countdown test for the Artemis II moonshot
item.description: The two-day test will culminate Thursday with the attempted fill-up of the rocket's fuel tanks.

item.title: Key quotes from the Rev. Jesse Jackson that define his politics and legacy
item.description: He was known as one of the Civil Rights Movement's most dynamic orators.

item.title: Erie town manager’s job up in the air as council disagrees on path forward
item.description: Erie Mayor Andrew Moore said he has "concluded that it is time for a change at the top."

item.title: Broomfield girls basketball breaks away in win over Mead
item.description: With the clock ticking ever closer to midnight on the regular season, two of the premier girls basketball teams from the St. Vrain Valley and Boulder Valley districts went to war Tuesday night.

item.title: Late surge lifts CU Buffs women’s basketball past Arizona
item.description: TUCSON, Arizona – Colorado was on the verge of a crushing loss on Tuesday when head coach JR Payne called a timeout. From that point, the Buffaloes looked like the surging team they’ve been in recent weeks.
